scope: Original public cardiopulmonary sources through the audit date; no HLS held-out audio, descriptors, recipes or metrics accessed.

interpretation.null: Unknown or not verified; never infer missing demographics, duration, purity or rights.
interpretation.defaults: Each dataset inherits every field in record_defaults; overrides below are explicit verified facts or labelled estimates. Consumers must shallow-merge record_defaults with each dataset.
interpretation.tier_A: High-confidence isolated sources or genuinely paired separation references; no external candidate is proven Tier A here.
interpretation.tier_B: Potential imperfect-source pretraining material. Candidate status is not acceptance; recording-level purity and technical gates remain necessary.
interpretation.tier_C: Domain/representation information only, not clean source-separation ground truth.
interpretation.rejected: Not selected for this program; does not imply the dataset lacks other scientific uses.
interpretation.count_scope: Publication cohort, public release, file paths, independent acquisitions and accepted training inventory are distinct quantities.
interpretation.subject_rule: Keep all linked subject IDs together, including CirCor Additional ID connected components. Session/date proxies are not verified person identity.
